text: In a North Denver suburb in 1978, a child killer known as the Grabber [takes boy after boy off the streets|trigger|someone goes missing], while Finney Blake and his sister Gwen endure [an abusive, drunken father|wrong|cruelty at home]. Locked in a soundproofed basement, Finney finds a disconnected black telephone on the wall that rings on its own, and on the line [the Grabber's dead victims|rules|the dead do not rest] tell him how to escape. Above, Gwen dreams of where he is being held.
